other_notes.heading: Prior Provisions
other_notes.text: A prior section 5403, act Aug. 16, 1954, ch. 736, 68A Stat. 674 , consisted of provisions similar to those comprising this section, prior to the general revision of this chapter by Pub. L. 85–859.
